_comment: Second test of the graded injection, on the channel where passage text actually decides the ranking. The first attempt used template_plus_projection, whose subspace projection pushes every injected vector toward the query directions; when projection sets the ranking, passage text is irrelevant and the alignment gradient changes nothing, so all 192 attacked queries were fully contaminated again. This config keeps the word-level 'template' attack (no projection) in both the plain and the epsilon-restricted form, plus the projection attack at a LOW lambda so the lexical channel still has influence. The aim is to find whether the alignment gradient moves poison_share into intermediate values.
